children: Cardano's Dijkstra era hard fork now has stated enactment windows in IO's technical delivery plan. A moderate-confidence window runs between December 5 and January 4, with a high-confidence window between February 24 and March 26. The upgrade is Cardano's next era-defining hard fork, carrying Plutus V4, new protocol parameters, and Constitutional amendments.

The stated windows turn the fork from a general roadmap item into a dated catalyst. Readiness work, including Plutus V4 support and protocol parameter changes, will likely determine which window is used, so progress reports between now and enactment carry informational weight.
If the moderate-confidence window slips, the February-to-March range provides a fallback, and enactment itself is the point where the new era rules take effect on mainnet.
